description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Oil Filter Stand
Stand Threads into the Engine Block
Oil Filter Threads onto Stand (after it has been threaded into the engine block)
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Filter Stand
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
